hero.title: Building the Future of Energy
hero.description: Oxalá is an integrated energy company committed to delivering sustainable energy solutions through innovation, safety, and operational excellence.

companyOverview.title: Who We Are
companyOverview.paragraph1: For more than 25 years, Oxalá has contributed to the development of the energy industry through safe, efficient, and sustainable operations.
companyOverview.paragraph2: We integrate upstream, downstream, energy distribution, and renewable energy businesses to create long-term value for customers and society.

visionMission.vision: To Become a Leading Company in Building a Sustainable Ecosystem

missions.1: Enhance human resource competencies based on the company's core values (AKHLAK).
missions.2: Deliver high-quality products and services using advanced technology and integrated systems.
missions.3: Strengthen financial management, risk management, and corporate governance.
missions.4: Optimize a well-measured business portfolio while supporting national development toward an advanced Indonesia.
missions.5: Expand international business networks by becoming a trusted player in the global construction market.
missions.6: Promote social responsibility and environmental sustainability in all business activities.
